All Roads to Peace#001.src: Hm. It's been long enough, we should've heard back from the diplomacy squad by now...
All Roads to Peace#001.dst: Hm. Es ist lange genug her, der Diplomatentrupp hätte sich längst melden müssen...
All Roads to Peace#001.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#002.src: Ah, hello there, Wynn soldier. You should stick around! We were just launching a counterattack against the orc citadel.
All Roads to Peace#002.dst: Ah, hallo, Soldat aus Wynn. Bleib doch! Wir starten gerade einen Gegenangriff auf die Orkzitadelle.
All Roads to Peace#002.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#003.src: Since you've helped with curbing the orcs elsewhere, you can join in the festivities- Oh, that's them coming over the hills!
All Roads to Peace#003.dst: Du hast ja schon anderswo geholfen, die Orks einzudämmen, also mach bei der Feier mit- Oh, da kommen sie über die Hügel!
All Roads to Peace#003.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#004.src: I don't know, but they just decimated our golems with it. How are we supposed to deal with that chieftain without our protection?
All Roads to Peace#004.dst: Keine Ahnung, aber damit haben sie unsere Golems vernichtet. Wie sollen wir ohne Schutz mit diesem Häuptling fertigwerden?
All Roads to Peace#004.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#005.src: Let's just get to the medical tent and go from there. The captain will need to hear about this.
All Roads to Peace#005.dst: Gehen wir erst mal ins Lazarettzelt und sehen dann weiter. Der Hauptmann muss davon erfahren.
All Roads to Peace#005.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#006.src: ...why do you always have to embarrass me in front of the humans, you idiots...
All Roads to Peace#006.dst: ...warum blamiert ihr mich immer vor den Menschen, ihr Idioten...
All Roads to Peace#006.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#007.src: Follow the captain to the medical tent at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
All Roads to Peace#007.dst: Folge dem Hauptmann zum Lazarettzelt bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

All Roads to Peace#008.src: You lot are useless, you are! We had you sent off with thirty golems! THIRTY! And you come back with nothing to show? Do you have any idea how much that cost us?!
All Roads to Peace#008.dst: Ihr seid nutzlos, jawohl! Wir haben euch mit dreißig Golems losgeschickt! DREISSIG! Und ihr kommt mit leeren Händen zurück? Wisst ihr, was uns das gekostet hat?!
All Roads to Peace#008.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#009.src: ...fine. I suppose you have a point. And that means it's a good thing we have a human here to pick up all your slack.
All Roads to Peace#009.dst: ...schön. Da hast du wohl recht. Und darum ist es gut, dass ein Mensch hier ist, der euer Versagen ausbügelt.
All Roads to Peace#009.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#010.src: There have been many attacks here at town, and we've been struggling to fend them off. Thanks to the incompetence of our troops, we haven't been able to-
All Roads to Peace#010.dst: Die Stadt wurde oft angegriffen, und wir können die Angriffe kaum abwehren. Dank der Unfähigkeit unserer Truppen konnten wir nicht-
All Roads to Peace#010.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#011.src: ORC CATAPULT!! ORC CATAPULT!! Listen to the words I am telling you! ORC! CATAPULT!
All Roads to Peace#011.dst: ORK-KATAPULT!! ORK-KATAPULT!! Hören Sie, was ich Ihnen sage! ORK! KATAPULT!
All Roads to Peace#011.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#012.src: ...we haven't been able to get the orc chieftain to listen to reason and sign a new ceasefire yet. If this keeps up, we'll be overwhelmed. The brutes only seem to listen to force...
All Roads to Peace#012.dst: ...konnten wir den Orkhäuptling noch nicht zur Vernunft bringen und zu einer neuen Waffenruhe bewegen. So werden wir bald überrannt. Die Rohlinge hören wohl nur auf Gewalt...
All Roads to Peace#012.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#013.src: The fortress is off to the northeast, it's visible from town. Don't come back without a ceasefire- Or the chieftain's head, if peace is out of the question!
All Roads to Peace#013.dst: Die Festung liegt im Nordosten, man sieht sie von der Stadt aus. Komm nicht ohne Waffenruhe zurück- oder ohne den Kopf des Häuptlings, falls Frieden unmöglich ist!
All Roads to Peace#013.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#015.src: Hmh! Human! Just like say, Serepe. Villager fail, then send human to kill.
All Roads to Peace#015.dst: Hmh! Mensch! Wie gesagt, Serepe. Dörfler scheitern, dann schicken Mensch zum Töten.
All Roads to Peace#015.speaker: Guard Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#016.src: Idiot big-noses! Human strong, but only one. Need more to break Centerworld!
All Roads to Peace#016.dst: Idioten-Großnasen! Mensch stark, aber nur einer. Brauchen mehr für Centerworld!
All Roads to Peace#016.speaker: Guard Serepe

All Roads to Peace#018.src: Idiot. Idiot human. Will die in open. Come.
All Roads to Peace#018.dst: Idiot. Idiot-Mensch. Sterben im Freien. Komm.

All Roads to Peace#019.src: RRRGHH! Armor heavy! How human carry much weight, but so weak without?!
All Roads to Peace#019.dst: RRRGHH! Rüstung schwer! Wie Mensch tragen so viel, aber ohne so schwach?!

All Roads to Peace#020.src: Need medicine for...urgh. Blood... Where yarrow root...
All Roads to Peace#020.dst: Brauchen Medizin für...urgh. Blut... Wo Schafgarbenwurzel...

All Roads to Peace#021.src: Name Zuett. Your name, Idiot. But only because taught wrong. So will help idiot. Take medicine.
All Roads to Peace#021.dst: Name Zuett. Dein Name Idiot. Aber nur, weil falsch gelehrt. Also hilft Idiot. Nimm Medizin.

All Roads to Peace#022.src: Hmh! Better than silly magic potion. Earth heals best...
All Roads to Peace#022.dst: Hmh! Besser als dummer Zaubertrank. Erde heilt am besten...
All Roads to Peace#022.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#023.src: Hmh. Mhm, mhm. Yes, idiot villagers come by, lots of metal villager too. Say want peace- just want kill. Evil war machines.
All Roads to Peace#023.dst: Hmh. Mhm, mhm. Ja, Idiot-Dörfler kommen, viele Metall-Dörfler auch. Sagen wollen Frieden- wollen nur töten. Böse Kriegsmaschinen.
All Roads to Peace#023.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#024.src: Human really want peace? Then listen to Zuett. Killing not the way. Orcs strong, but not killers. Villager say, but villager wrong.
All Roads to Peace#024.dst: Mensch wirklich wollen Frieden? Dann hör Zuett. Töten nicht der Weg. Orks stark, aber nicht Mörder. Dörfler sagen, aber Dörfler falsch.
All Roads to Peace#024.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#025.src: We... Orcs... Not listen to just force. Orcs see strength, not idiot-killing. Human been idiot-killing. Time to stop.
All Roads to Peace#025.dst: Wir... Orks... Hören nicht nur auf Gewalt. Orks sehen Stärke, nicht Idiotentöten. Mensch hat idiotengetötet. Zeit aufhören.
All Roads to Peace#025.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#026.src: Whole war stupid. War killing us. Not all Orcs meant to fight. Human need learn first.
All Roads to Peace#026.dst: Ganzer Krieg dumm. Krieg tötet uns. Nicht alle Orks zum Kämpfen gemacht. Mensch muss erst lernen.
All Roads to Peace#026.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#027.src: Need talk with Arrai-Veretel. But first, need trust. To start trust, listen to Zuett.
All Roads to Peace#027.dst: Muss reden mit Arrai-Veretel. Aber zuerst Vertrauen. Für Anfang Vertrauen, hör Zuett.
All Roads to Peace#027.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#028.src: Will give guards peace offer. [Elite Boar Meat]. Go hunt. Look bushes up north.
All Roads to Peace#028.dst: Geben Wachen Friedensgabe. [Elite Boar Meat]. Geh jagen. Such Büsche im Norden.
All Roads to Peace#028.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#029.src: If want walk away like coward, do now. If human trust me...meet by fort after get meat.
All Roads to Peace#029.dst: Wenn weggehen wie Feigling, jetzt tun. Wenn Mensch mir traut...treffen bei Festung nach Fleisch.
All Roads to Peace#029.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#030.src: Travel to the hunting grounds at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

All Roads to Peace#031.src: Speak to Zuett with the Elite Boar Meat at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
All Roads to Peace#031.dst: Bring Zuett das Elite Boar Meat bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

All Roads to Peace#032.src: Hmh. Hunt like child, but succeed anyway. Human should rely less on magic. Human serious, though.
All Roads to Peace#032.dst: Hmh. Jagen wie Kind, aber trotzdem Erfolg. Mensch sollte weniger Magie nutzen. Mensch aber ernst.
All Roads to Peace#032.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#033.src: Good. Human really want peace. Help stop stupid war... Even though human and villager start anyway...
All Roads to Peace#033.dst: Gut. Mensch wirklich will Frieden. Hilft dummen Krieg stoppen... Auch wenn Mensch und Dörfler ihn anfangen...
All Roads to Peace#033.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#034.src: Follow. We go Centerworld. Guards still angry, but can say good for you. Stay quiet- Zuett do talk.
All Roads to Peace#034.dst: Folgen. Wir gehen Centerworld. Wachen noch wütend, aber kann Gutes sagen für dich. Still sein- Zuett redet.
All Roads to Peace#034.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#035.src: Zuett! What you do? Thought drag away human to kill for good! Why bringing back now?
All Roads to Peace#035.dst: Zuett! Was du tun? Dachte, Mensch wegschleppen für Töten! Warum jetzt zurückbringen?
All Roads to Peace#035.speaker: Guard Serepe

All Roads to Peace#036.src: Zuett bleeding heart. Strong in compassion. Saw hurt, thought help. Stupid, but can respect.
All Roads to Peace#036.dst: Zuett weiches Herz. Stark in Mitleid. Sah Verletzt, dachte helfen. Dumm, aber kann respektieren.
All Roads to Peace#036.speaker: Guard Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#037.src: Listen to Zuett! Human want peace. Came for peace, but was taught peace come from idiot-killing by villager.
All Roads to Peace#037.dst: Hört Zuett! Mensch will Frieden. Kam für Frieden, aber Dörfler lehrten, Frieden kommt von Idiotentöten.
All Roads to Peace#037.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#038.src: Grrrh! All human say! What special about this human?
All Roads to Peace#038.dst: Grrrh! Alle Menschen sagen! Was besonders an diesem Mensch?
All Roads to Peace#038.speaker: Guard Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#039.src: Human listen to Zuett. Hunt spineback boar, bring meat. See? If human not care, human not listen. Not hunt.
All Roads to Peace#039.dst: Mensch hört Zuett. Jagt Stachelrückeneber, bringt Fleisch. Siehst? Wenn Mensch egal, Mensch hört nicht. Jagt nicht.
All Roads to Peace#039.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#040.src: But strong not mean trust! Strength of body only one thing.
All Roads to Peace#040.dst: Aber stark heißt nicht Vertrauen! Stärke von Körper nur eine Sache.
All Roads to Peace#040.speaker: Guard Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#041.src: RESSINTER HURT! RESSINTER HURT BAD! NEED HELP!! HELP NOW!!
All Roads to Peace#041.dst: RESSINTER VERLETZT! RESSINTER SCHLIMM! BRAUCHEN HILFE!! HILFE JETZT!!

All Roads to Peace#042.src: Onluk! Tell what happen! Ressinter...healer hurt?
All Roads to Peace#042.dst: Onluk! Sag, was passiert! Ressinter...Heiler verletzt?
All Roads to Peace#042.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#043.src: KREIMU! Get Kreimu! Mudspring camp! She good healer!
All Roads to Peace#043.dst: KREIMU! Hol Kreimu! Lager Mudspring! Sie gute Heilerin!
All Roads to Peace#043.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#044.src: Will go! Fast runner! Ressinter no die today! Serepe, deal with human!
All Roads to Peace#044.dst: Gehe! Schneller Läufer! Ressinter heute nicht sterben! Serepe, Mensch bewachen!
All Roads to Peace#044.speaker: Guard Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#045.src: Gwuh?! Zuett! Lying bad! Human idiot no hea-
All Roads to Peace#045.dst: Gwuh?! Zuett! Lügen böse! Idiot-Mensch nicht hei-
All Roads to Peace#045.speaker: Guard Serepe

All Roads to Peace#046.src: RESSINTER DYING! NO CARE IF LIE! ANY HEALER BETTER THAN NO HEALER!
All Roads to Peace#046.dst: RESSINTER STIRBT! EGAL OB LÜGE! JEDER HEILER BESSER ALS KEIN HEILER!
All Roads to Peace#046.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#047.src: HEY! ONLUK IDIOT! NO LET HUMAN IN!
All Roads to Peace#047.dst: HEY! ONLUK IDIOT! NICHT MENSCH REINLASSEN!
All Roads to Peace#047.speaker: Guard Serepe

All Roads to Peace#049.src: Follow Onluk to the Medicine Tent through the fortress
All Roads to Peace#049.dst: Folge Onluk durch die Festung zum Medizinzelt

All Roads to Peace#050.src: Cannon backfire! Caught in blast! Cut up all over, bleeding bad! Healer already brought medicine tent!
All Roads to Peace#050.dst: Kanone nach hinten los! In Explosion! Überall Schnitte, blutet schlimm! Heiler schon in Medizinzelt gebracht!
All Roads to Peace#050.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#051.src: Hhhgh. Bad injury... Human. Heal Ressinter, fast!
All Roads to Peace#051.dst: Hhhgh. Schlimme Wunde... Mensch. Heil Ressinter, schnell!
All Roads to Peace#051.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#052.src: Make balm to keep healer alive! Even if only keep alive for Kreimu to heal, keep Ressinter alive!
All Roads to Peace#052.dst: Mach Salbe, Heiler am Leben halten! Auch wenn nur am Leben, bis Kreimu heilt, halt Ressinter am Leben!
All Roads to Peace#052.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#053.src: Mix herbs. Use medicine book. And stay in tent!
All Roads to Peace#053.dst: Kräuter mischen. Buch benutzen. Und im Zelt bleiben!
All Roads to Peace#053.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#054.src: Save the injured orc, or keep it alive until rescue arrives
All Roads to Peace#054.dst: Rette den verletzten Ork oder halte ihn am Leben, bis Hilfe eintrifft

All Roads to Peace#055.src: This is the medicine book Zuett talked about...but almost all of the words are in Orcish! There are pictures of each plant, and readable names, but...
All Roads to Peace#055.dst: Das ist das Medizinbuch, von dem Zuett sprach...aber fast alles ist auf Orkisch! Es gibt Bilder jeder Pflanze und lesbare Namen, aber...

All Roads to Peace#058.src: Gwuh, yes! Stop shouting! I- Urgh!
All Roads to Peace#058.dst: Gwuh, ja! Nicht schreien! Ich- Urgh!
All Roads to Peace#058.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#059.src: Here in time. Ressinter still alive...why other balm on cuts?
All Roads to Peace#059.dst: Rechtzeitig hier. Ressinter lebt noch...warum andere Salbe auf Schnitt?
All Roads to Peace#059.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#060.src: Wait, why human here? Ressinter hurt because human?
All Roads to Peace#060.dst: Moment, warum Mensch hier? Ressinter verletzt wegen Mensch?
All Roads to Peace#060.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#062.src: Human try heal Ressinter. Thought better healer than Zuett. Try hard to keep Ressinter alive.
All Roads to Peace#062.dst: Mensch versucht Ressinter heilen. Dachte, besser Heiler als Zuett. Hat hart versucht, Ressinter halten.
All Roads to Peace#062.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#063.src: ... ... ...Nunexetor. You sensible. Is true? Human try heal Ressinter?
All Roads to Peace#063.dst: ... ... ...Nunexetor. Du vernünftig. Ist wahr? Mensch versucht Ressinter heilen?
All Roads to Peace#063.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#064.src: Yes. The human made herb balms and tried to heal Ressinter.
All Roads to Peace#064.dst: Ja. Der Mensch hat Kräutersalben gemacht, um Ressinter zu heilen.
All Roads to Peace#064.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#065.src: So Zuett not lie. Human care about orc?
All Roads to Peace#065.dst: Also Zuett nicht lügt. Mensch kümmert sich um Ork?
All Roads to Peace#065.speaker: Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#066.src: See? Human try. Maybe not heal Ressinter full, but try save life of someone call enemy by idiot Villager.
All Roads to Peace#066.dst: Siehst? Mensch versucht. Heilt Ressinter vielleicht nicht ganz, aber will Leben retten von Feind von Idiot-Dörfler.
All Roads to Peace#066.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#067.src: Human learn Villagers lie. Trying learn about us. War only because Villagers trick! Not because human bad!
All Roads to Peace#067.dst: Mensch lernt, Dörfler lügen. Versucht lernen über uns. Krieg nur wegen Dörfler-Trick! Nicht weil Mensch böse!
All Roads to Peace#067.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#068.src: ...hmh! Can respect. Strong in mind if able to learn.
All Roads to Peace#068.dst: ...hmh! Kann respektieren. Stark im Kopf, wenn kann lernen.
All Roads to Peace#068.speaker: Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#070.src: Will stay for while in case Ressinter need medicine more.
All Roads to Peace#070.dst: Bleibe eine Weile, falls Ressinter mehr Medizin braucht.
All Roads to Peace#070.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#071.src: Sorry to put human up to task sudden, but now more orc trust you.
All Roads to Peace#071.dst: Tut leid, Mensch plötzlich Aufgabe geben, aber jetzt mehr Orks dir trauen.
All Roads to Peace#071.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#072.src: Since orc trust...maybe can talk to Arrai-Veretel now. Follow.
All Roads to Peace#072.dst: Weil Orks vertrauen...vielleicht jetzt mit Arrai-Veretel reden. Folgen.
All Roads to Peace#072.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#074.src: No! Lomoster okay! Ressinter not okay- Wait. Ressinter sort of okay! Need rest still!
All Roads to Peace#074.dst: Nein! Lomoster gut! Ressinter nicht gut- Warte. Ressinter irgendwie gut! Braucht noch Ruhe!
All Roads to Peace#074.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#075.src: But Lomoster at cannon when explode!
All Roads to Peace#075.dst: Aber Lomoster bei Kanone, als explodiert!
All Roads to Peace#075.speaker: Ressinter

All Roads to Peace#076.src: Lomoster wear armor. Armor took hurt, Lomoster okay!
All Roads to Peace#076.dst: Lomoster trägt Rüstung. Rüstung kriegt Schaden, Lomoster gut!
All Roads to Peace#076.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#078.src: Human heal Ressinter. See? Human good healer!
All Roads to Peace#078.dst: Mensch heilt Ressinter. Siehst? Mensch guter Heiler!
All Roads to Peace#078.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#079.src: I don't believe it. How did-
All Roads to Peace#079.dst: Ich glaub es nicht. Wie hat-
All Roads to Peace#079.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#080.src: Gwuh, yes! Stop shouting! I- Whuh...
All Roads to Peace#080.dst: Gwuh, ja! Nicht schreien! Ich- Whuh...
All Roads to Peace#080.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#082.src: Wait, Ressinter okay? How did- HUMAN?! WHY HUMAN IN CAMP?!
All Roads to Peace#082.dst: Moment, Ressinter gut? Wie- MENSCH?! WARUM MENSCH IN LAGER?!
All Roads to Peace#082.speaker: Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#083.src: Human heal Ressinter! Not know how, but human save Ressinter life!
All Roads to Peace#083.dst: Mensch heilt Ressinter! Nicht wissen wie, aber Mensch rettet Ressinter Leben!
All Roads to Peace#083.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#084.src: Told Bitteliso. Human learning! Save life of orc, even though idiot Villager say kill.
All Roads to Peace#084.dst: Hab Bitteliso gesagt. Mensch lernt! Rettet Leben von Ork, obwohl Idiot-Dörfler sagt töten.
All Roads to Peace#084.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#085.src: ...how. How. HOW! How human so good at healing?! Why human help?
All Roads to Peace#085.dst: ...wie. Wie. WIE! Wie Mensch so gut heilen?! Warum Mensch hilft?
All Roads to Peace#085.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#086.src: Can trust human. Human try unlearn bad villager teach.
All Roads to Peace#086.dst: Kann Mensch trauen. Mensch versucht verlernen, was böse Dörfler lehren.
All Roads to Peace#086.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#087.src: ...fine. Good human, not stupid human. Bitteliso sorry for beating. Here.
All Roads to Peace#087.dst: ...gut. Guter Mensch, nicht dummer Mensch. Bitteliso tut leid wegen Prügel. Hier.
All Roads to Peace#087.speaker: Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#088.src: Shouldn't we get back to what we were doing?
All Roads to Peace#088.dst: Sollten wir nicht weitermachen, wo wir waren?
All Roads to Peace#088.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#089.src: ...will stay in case Ressinter need help.
All Roads to Peace#089.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#090.src: Ressinter not old man! No need sitter!
All Roads to Peace#090.dst: Ressinter nicht alter Mann! Braucht keinen Aufpasser!
All Roads to Peace#090.speaker: Ressinter

All Roads to Peace#091.src: Not know that human actually good at heal! Very good! Healer, not hunter. More orc trust you now.
All Roads to Peace#091.dst: Nicht gewusst, Mensch wirklich gut im Heilen! Sehr gut! Heiler, nicht Jäger. Mehr Orks vertrauen dir jetzt.
All Roads to Peace#091.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#092.src: Since orc trust...maybe can talk to Arrai-Veretel now. Follow!
All Roads to Peace#092.dst: Weil Orks vertrauen...vielleicht jetzt mit Arrai-Veretel reden. Folgen!
All Roads to Peace#092.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#093.src: Follow Zuett through the Orcish Fortress

All Roads to Peace#094.src: No enter! Much camp see human heal, but still no trust human!
All Roads to Peace#094.dst: Nicht rein! Viel Lager sieht Mensch heilen, aber noch kein Vertrauen!
All Roads to Peace#094.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#095.src: Ureietun! Human save Ressinter life! Why no trust?
All Roads to Peace#095.dst: Ureietun! Mensch rettet Ressinter! Warum kein Vertrauen?
All Roads to Peace#095.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#096.src: Human being led by you. Human led by villager too! Teach good thing, yes, but what if human just copying?
All Roads to Peace#096.dst: Mensch von dir geführt. Mensch auch von Dörfler geführt! Lehrst gut, ja, aber was, wenn Mensch nur nachmacht?
All Roads to Peace#096.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#097.src: Human can earn trust alone! Zuett, stay in Arrai-room.
All Roads to Peace#097.dst: Mensch verdient Vertrauen allein! Zuett, bleib in Arrai-Raum.
All Roads to Peace#097.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#099.src: RRRRRGH! STUPID ZUETT! WAR HAPPEN FOR REASON! GO AWAY!
All Roads to Peace#099.dst: RRRRRGH! DUMMER ZUETT! KRIEG HAT GRUND! GEH WEG!
All Roads to Peace#099.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#100.src: Can trust human not kill. Human can walk around Centerworld. But human no see Arrai-Veretel!
All Roads to Peace#100.dst: Kann vertrauen, Mensch nicht tötet. Mensch darf durch Centerworld gehen. Aber nicht Arrai-Veretel sehen!
All Roads to Peace#100.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#101.src: Ask various orcs if they need any help at the Orcish Fortress at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
All Roads to Peace#101.dst: Frag verschiedene Orks in der Orkfestung bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], ob sie Hilfe brauchen.

All Roads to Peace#102.src: Hm! Human, hunter, healer, halfwit soldier. Many things! Human also runner?
All Roads to Peace#102.dst: Hm! Mensch, Jäger, Heiler, Trottel-Soldat. Viele Sachen! Mensch auch Läufer?
All Roads to Peace#102.speaker: Peloros

All Roads to Peace#103.src: Peloros from Holehold. Camp home to messengers and runners. Have thing to deliver to Fruludir in green tower.
All Roads to Peace#103.dst: Peloros aus Holehold. Lager von Boten und Läufern. Hab Ding für Fruludir in grünem Turm.
All Roads to Peace#103.speaker: Peloros

All Roads to Peace#105.src: Then human run fast to green tower- deliver in {~} seconds! Or else come back. Not urgent delivery, so delay fine.
All Roads to Peace#105.dst: Dann Mensch schnell zu grünem Turm- liefern in {~} Sekunden! Sonst zurückkommen. Nicht dringend, Verspätung okay.
All Roads to Peace#105.speaker: Peloros

All Roads to Peace#106.src: Will know human delivered in time. How? Human will see if run fast!
All Roads to Peace#106.dst: Werde wissen, ob Mensch rechtzeitig. Wie? Mensch sieht, wenn schnell läuft!
All Roads to Peace#106.speaker: Peleros

All Roads to Peace#108.src: RGH! Can understand just fine, just not speak as good! No mock us!
All Roads to Peace#108.dst: RGH! Verstehen gut, nur nicht so gut sprechen! Nicht uns verspotten!
All Roads to Peace#108.speaker: Peleros

All Roads to Peace#109.src: Hm! Human have Peloros box. Peloros give human run training. Give here.
All Roads to Peace#109.dst: Hm! Mensch hat Peloros-Kiste. Peloros gibt Mensch Lauftraining. Gib her.
All Roads to Peace#109.speaker: Fruludir

All Roads to Peace#110.src: More than Zuett with human? Good sign. Maybe fighting stop soon.
All Roads to Peace#110.dst: Mehr als Zuett mit Mensch? Gutes Zeichen. Vielleicht Kampf bald vorbei.
All Roads to Peace#110.speaker: Fruludir

All Roads to Peace#111.src: Patience, human. Box full of signal flare. Will light one to show Peloros human got here in time.
All Roads to Peace#111.dst: Geduld, Mensch. Kiste voll Leuchtsignale. Zünde eins, damit Peloros sieht, Mensch rechtzeitig.
All Roads to Peace#111.speaker: Fruludir

All Roads to Peace#112.src: Saw the firework. Human did well, finishing single morning exercise!
All Roads to Peace#112.dst: Feuerwerk gesehen. Mensch gut gemacht, einzige Morgenübung geschafft!
All Roads to Peace#112.speaker: Peloros

All Roads to Peace#113.src: Orc do much training to stay strong. Orc runners must be fast and not tire to become Marathon!
All Roads to Peace#113.dst: Ork trainiert viel für stark bleiben. Ork-Läufer müssen schnell und nie müde sein für Marathon werden!
All Roads to Peace#113.speaker: Peloros

All Roads to Peace#114.src: Here. Human take. Train harder. Maybe visit Holehold- also place for relax, not just run. Stamina good for all.
All Roads to Peace#114.dst: Hier. Mensch nimm. Härter trainieren. Vielleicht Holehold besuchen- auch Ort für Ruhe, nicht nur Laufen. Ausdauer gut für alle.
All Roads to Peace#114.speaker: Peloros

All Roads to Peace#115.src: Oh. Human who help Ressinter. You are strange. Not like other human at all.
All Roads to Peace#115.dst: Oh. Mensch, der Ressinter hilft. Du bist seltsam. Gar nicht wie andere Menschen.
All Roads to Peace#115.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#116.src: This? This food storage. Mostly for meats and roots. Though, large ritual happening soon.
All Roads to Peace#116.dst: Das? Das Vorratslager. Meist für Fleisch und Wurzeln. Aber bald großes Ritual.
All Roads to Peace#116.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#117.src: Festival with Earthpit. Will be coming soon- so stocking up food for that.
All Roads to Peace#117.dst: Fest mit Earthpit. Kommt bald- darum Essen sammeln dafür.
All Roads to Peace#117.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#118.src: ...human look like want help. You...really are strange. I suppose...if you want help with food, could do some fishing.
All Roads to Peace#118.dst: ...Mensch sieht aus, als will helfen. Du...bist wirklich seltsam. Wenn du bei Essen helfen willst...könntest angeln.
All Roads to Peace#118.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#119.src: Won't ask human to do everything- just [{~} Carp Meat] enough to help. Though, could bring more if wanted.
All Roads to Peace#119.dst: Verlange nicht alles von Mensch- nur [{~} Carp Meat] reicht. Kannst aber mehr bringen, wenn willst.
All Roads to Peace#119.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#120.src: If want bring more than {~}, will accept more than {~}.
All Roads to Peace#120.dst: Wenn mehr als {~} bringen willst, nehme mehr als {~}.
All Roads to Peace#120.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#121.src: Mhm, mhm. You are strange human, but not bad human. This enough meat.
All Roads to Peace#121.dst: Mhm, mhm. Du seltsamer Mensch, aber nicht schlechter Mensch. Das genug Fleisch.
All Roads to Peace#121.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#122.src: Festival will still be long time away, but here. Since human help, you get reward. Only fair.
All Roads to Peace#122.dst: Fest noch lange hin, aber hier. Weil Mensch hilft, kriegst Belohnung. Nur fair.
All Roads to Peace#122.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#123.src: Oh, you brought more fish than asked. Twice as much as asked!
All Roads to Peace#123.dst: Oh, mehr Fisch gebracht als verlangt. Doppelt so viel!
All Roads to Peace#123.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#124.src: You are good human. Strange, but not bad. Willing to put in extra effort.
All Roads to Peace#124.dst: Du guter Mensch. Seltsam, aber nicht schlecht. Bereit für Extramühe.
All Roads to Peace#124.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#125.src: Here- will also share some meat that won't be for festival. Other rewards too.
All Roads to Peace#125.dst: Hier- teile auch Fleisch, das nicht für Fest ist. Andere Belohnung auch.
All Roads to Peace#125.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#126.src: ...that is...much fish. You heard me when I said five, right?
All Roads to Peace#126.dst: ...das ist...viel Fisch. Du hast gehört, ich sagte fünf, ja?
All Roads to Peace#126.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#127.src: Four times as much as fair share. Why human like this?
All Roads to Peace#127.dst: Viermal so viel wie fair. Warum Mensch so?
All Roads to Peace#127.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#128.src: Humans are supposed to be selfish. Listen to villager and kill orc. But you are not like that at all.
All Roads to Peace#128.dst: Menschen sollen egoistisch sein. Hören auf Dörfler und töten Ork. Aber du gar nicht so.
All Roads to Peace#128.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#129.src: Then here- Will share extra meat. Not for festival, but still good. Other thing too. Thank you very much, human.
All Roads to Peace#129.dst: Dann hier- teile Extrafleisch. Nicht für Fest, aber trotzdem gut. Anderes Ding auch. Vielen Dank, Mensch.
All Roads to Peace#129.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#131.src: Said five. You have thirty. I...how and why.
All Roads to Peace#131.dst: Sagte fünf. Du hast dreißig. Ich...wie und warum.
All Roads to Peace#131.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#132.src: You just did work of six orc. You are...overachieving human. But that is not bad thing!
All Roads to Peace#132.dst: Du hast Arbeit von sechs Orks gemacht. Du bist...Übereifer-Mensch. Aber das nicht schlecht!
All Roads to Peace#132.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#133.src: Here, then. This meat not for festival, but you deserve hearty meal for all effort!
All Roads to Peace#133.dst: Dann hier. Fleisch nicht für Fest, aber du verdienst gutes Essen für ganze Mühe!
All Roads to Peace#133.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#134.src: That much fish actually meet quota! Thank you so much, strange, kind human!
All Roads to Peace#134.dst: So viel Fisch erfüllt sogar Soll! Vielen Dank, seltsamer, netter Mensch!
All Roads to Peace#134.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#135.src: Human OFFERING help- Hmh! Very good human! Task simple. Southeast of fort, past ridge, Teiren old camp.
All Roads to Peace#135.dst: Mensch BIETET Hilfe an- Hmh! Sehr guter Mensch! Aufgabe einfach. Südost von Festung, hinter Grat, Teiren altes Lager.
All Roads to Peace#135.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#136.src: Used to live, but left because Freelancer jump down from mountain. Forgot important thing there!
All Roads to Peace#136.dst: Hat da gewohnt, aber weg, weil Freelancer von Berg runterspringen. Wichtiges Ding da vergessen!
All Roads to Peace#136.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#137.src: Need stay here, make sure stupid Peloros no run into firepit. Has done before. So, you go get!
All Roads to Peace#137.dst: Muss hierbleiben, aufpassen, dummer Peloros nicht in Feuergrube rennt. Schon passiert. Also du holen!
All Roads to Peace#137.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#138.src: Oi, oi! Y'oughta gimme 'at back right now, li'l lady!
All Roads to Peace#138.dst: Ey, ey! Gib ma dat sofort zurück, Kleine!
All Roads to Peace#138.speaker: Freelancer

All Roads to Peace#139.src: Absolutely NOT, you craven wind spirit! This belongs to me now!
All Roads to Peace#139.dst: Auf GAR keinen Fall, du feiger Windgeist! Das gehört jetzt mir!
All Roads to Peace#139.speaker: Alraune

All Roads to Peace#140.src: Nonsense! This camp was built by those who respected the earth and its bounties. Now that its inhabitants have left, nature is free to reclaim it, as is right!
All Roads to Peace#140.dst: Unsinn! Dieses Lager bauten jene, die die Erde und ihre Gaben achteten. Nun, da sie fort sind, darf die Natur es zurückfordern, wie es rechtens ist!
All Roads to Peace#140.speaker: Alraune

All Roads to Peace#141.src: Aw yeah? Issat it? You're a peach, gal, but I'll clip those petals, you don't give it up right now!
All Roads to Peace#141.dst: Ach ja? Is dat so? Bist 'n Pfirsich, Mädel, aber ich stutz dir die Blüten, wenn de's nich sofort hergibst!
All Roads to Peace#141.speaker: Freelancer

All Roads to Peace#142.src: What a brutish lout you are, threatening an embodiment of nature! I won't give this up without a fight!
All Roads to Peace#142.dst: Was für ein grober Flegel, ein Abbild der Natur zu bedrohen! Kampflos gebe ich das nicht her!
All Roads to Peace#142.speaker: Alraune

All Roads to Peace#143.src: ...hm? And who might you be? What brings a human to this disused place?
All Roads to Peace#143.dst: ...hm? Und wer magst du sein? Was führt einen Menschen an diesen verlassenen Ort?
All Roads to Peace#143.speaker: Alraune

All Roads to Peace#144.src: Oh no, you want this too?! I have claimed it for my own! Leave me be, go! Get out of here!
All Roads to Peace#144.dst: Oh nein, du willst das auch?! Ich habe es für mich beansprucht! Lass mich in Ruhe, geh! Fort mit dir!
All Roads to Peace#144.speaker: Alraune

All Roads to Peace#145.src: Shouldn'ta crossed me, doll! Remember who spreads your pollen next time, huh?! Now to just take this back up the mountain...
All Roads to Peace#145.dst: Hätt'st dich nich mit mir anlegen soll'n, Puppe! Denk dran, wer deine Pollen verteilt, was?! Jetz nur noch rauf auf'n Berg damit...
All Roads to Peace#145.speaker: Freelancer

All Roads to Peace#146.src: OI! Who's THIS joker now? You lookin' ta empty your wallet for me or something?
All Roads to Peace#146.dst: EY! Wer is DIESER Witzbold? Willste mir deine Börse leeren, oder was?
All Roads to Peace#146.speaker: Freelancer

All Roads to Peace#147.src: What, you want this thing too?! It's mine, y'hear? MINE! You can't have it!
All Roads to Peace#147.dst: Was, du willst dat Ding auch?! Dat is meins, hörste? MEINS! Kriegste nich!
All Roads to Peace#147.speaker: Freelancer

All Roads to Peace#148.src: Human! Was right to send out. Peloros fall over chair and almost burn! Did find thing? Very distinctive, only thing left at camp.
All Roads to Peace#148.dst: Mensch! Richtig, dich zu schicken. Peloros fällt über Stuhl und verbrennt fast! Ding gefunden? Sehr eigen, einziges Ding im Lager.
All Roads to Peace#148.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#149.src: Hmhm!! Yes! This what looking for! Very good human! Human deserve reward for be good human!
All Roads to Peace#149.dst: Hmhm!! Ja! Das gesucht! Sehr guter Mensch! Mensch verdient Belohnung für guter Mensch sein!
All Roads to Peace#149.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#150.src: Oh? Human not know what thing is? Want know?
All Roads to Peace#150.dst: Oh? Mensch weiß nicht, was Ding ist? Will wissen?
All Roads to Peace#150.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#151.src: Silly! If human not know what thing is, no tell! Can learn for self.
All Roads to Peace#151.dst: Dummerchen! Wenn Mensch nicht weiß, was Ding ist, nicht sagen! Selbst lernen.
All Roads to Peace#151.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#154.src: Hrrh! Human! You language dumb! Name smart, flow like water in Orc language, look like dungpile on paper in human language!
All Roads to Peace#154.dst: Hrrh! Mensch! Deine Sprache blöd! Name klug, fließt wie Wasser in Orksprache, sieht aus wie Misthaufen auf Papier in Menschensprache!
All Roads to Peace#154.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#155.src: Say name! Look at spell, say name! Try!! TRY!!!
All Roads to Peace#155.dst: Sag Namen! Schau Schrift, sag Namen! Versuch!! VERSUCH!!!
All Roads to Peace#155.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#156.src: GRRRH! Confusing name! Not confusing in orcish! Human say all wrong!
All Roads to Peace#156.dst: GRRRH! Verwirrender Name! Auf Orkisch nicht verwirrend! Mensch sagt alles falsch!
All Roads to Peace#156.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#157.src: Hmh. That right, human. Willing to try at least. See how bad name look?
All Roads to Peace#157.dst: Hmh. Richtig, Mensch. Versucht wenigstens. Siehst, wie schlimm Name aussieht?
All Roads to Peace#157.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#158.src: Said "shoon-bur." Not even LOOK like that in human letter!
All Roads to Peace#158.dst: Sagt "Schuun-bur." Sieht in Menschenschrift nicht mal SO aus!
All Roads to Peace#158.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#159.src: Here. Needed show anger at stupid language, not show anger at human.
All Roads to Peace#159.dst: Hier. Musste Wut an dummer Sprache zeigen, nicht Wut an Mensch.
All Roads to Peace#159.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#160.src: Stupid stupid STUPID! Not at all say like spell! See stupid language now?!
All Roads to Peace#160.dst: Dumm dumm DUMM! Gar nicht wie Schrift gesagt! Siehst jetzt dumme Sprache?!
All Roads to Peace#160.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#161.src: GAAAH!! No, no, no, no!!! Why need learn human language?!
All Roads to Peace#161.dst: GAAAH!! Nein, nein, nein, nein!!! Warum Menschensprache lernen?!
All Roads to Peace#161.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#162.src: NAME NOT JOE! WHAT KIND NAME JOE?! JOE STUPID NAME!!! AAAAHH!!
All Roads to Peace#162.dst: NAME NICHT JOE! WAS FÜR NAME JOE?! JOE DUMMER NAME!!! AAAAHH!!
All Roads to Peace#162.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#167.src: Rock stuck. Trying to lift- for train strength! No one able to lift rock.
All Roads to Peace#167.dst: Stein steckt fest. Versuche heben- für Krafttraining! Keiner kann Stein heben.
All Roads to Peace#167.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#168.src: Yunelsu try throw rock into river! Have thrown other rock, not this one.
All Roads to Peace#168.dst: Yunelsu versucht Stein in Fluss werfen! Andere Steine geworfen, nicht diesen.
All Roads to Peace#168.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#169.src: Hmm...human magic strong, but rock still not moving.
All Roads to Peace#169.dst: Hmm...Mensch-Magie stark, aber Stein bewegt sich nicht.
All Roads to Peace#169.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#170.src: Work together! Cast magic at rock, I try lift again! Ready!
All Roads to Peace#170.dst: Zusammen arbeiten! Zauber auf Stein, ich heb nochmal! Bereit!
All Roads to Peace#170.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#172.src: Hrrgh... Hrrf. Must be...old earth rock.
All Roads to Peace#172.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#173.src: Been here very long time. Stuck here, rock where earth wants rock to be.
All Roads to Peace#173.dst: Schon sehr lange hier. Steckt fest, Stein ist, wo Erde Stein will.
All Roads to Peace#173.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#174.src: Yunelsu find other rock then. Sometimes rock break, though.
All Roads to Peace#174.dst: Yunelsu sucht dann anderen Stein. Manchmal zerbricht Stein aber.
All Roads to Peace#174.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#175.src: See? Many broken rock. Hear can be good for armor though. You take.
All Roads to Peace#175.dst: Siehst? Viel kaputter Stein. Hör, gut für Rüstung. Du nimm.
All Roads to Peace#175.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#176.src: Oh! You! Saw Zuett dragging you to camp. And saw other thing.
All Roads to Peace#176.dst: Oh! Du! Sah Zuett dich ins Lager schleifen. Und sah anderes Ding.
All Roads to Peace#176.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#177.src: And you helped Ressinter! Will apologize later. Was my fault. Human seen Freelancers?
All Roads to Peace#177.dst: Und du hast Ressinter geholfen! Entschuldige später. War meine Schuld. Mensch Freelancer gesehen?
All Roads to Peace#177.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#178.src: Freelancers think everything belong to them. Loiter around fortress a lot, try to jump in sometimes.
All Roads to Peace#178.dst: Freelancer denken, alles gehört ihnen. Lungern viel um Festung, versuchen manchmal reinspringen.
All Roads to Peace#178.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#179.src: Was trying to shoot flying one down, but cannon broke, and cannonball explode.
All Roads to Peace#179.dst: Wollte fliegenden runterschießen, aber Kanone kaputt, und Kanonenkugel explodiert.
All Roads to Peace#179.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#180.src: Now Ressinter okay, but still need repair cannon. Human feel like helping, will need [{~} Iron Ingots] to repair.
All Roads to Peace#180.dst: Jetzt Ressinter gut, aber Kanone muss repariert werden. Wenn Mensch helfen will, brauche [{~} Iron Ingots] für Reparatur.
All Roads to Peace#180.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#181.src: Long walk, but there iron in valley east of villager quarry. There also other villager there, with weapons. Not sure why.
All Roads to Peace#181.dst: Langer Weg, aber Eisen in Tal östlich von Dörfler-Steinbruch. Da auch andere Dörfler, mit Waffen. Nicht sicher, warum.
All Roads to Peace#181.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#182.src: Human being weirdly helpful. That good though! Make Lomoster job of shooting enemy easier.
All Roads to Peace#182.dst: Mensch seltsam hilfsbereit. Aber gut! Macht Lomoster Arbeit von Feind-Schießen leichter.
All Roads to Peace#182.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#183.src: Here. Freelancer like steal metal and other thing too, have found a lot from shooting. Human can have.
All Roads to Peace#183.dst: Hier. Freelancer stehlen gern Metall und andere Dinge, hab viel gefunden beim Schießen. Mensch kann haben.
All Roads to Peace#183.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#184.src: Not good for repair cannon, but probably good for make other thing.
All Roads to Peace#184.dst: Nicht gut für Kanone reparieren, aber vielleicht gut für andere Dinge machen.
All Roads to Peace#184.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#185.src: Her name, my name, sound same. Don't sound same in Orcish! But in YOUR language, sound same!
All Roads to Peace#185.dst: Ihr Name, mein Name, klingt gleich. Klingt nicht gleich auf Orkisch! Aber in DEINER Sprache klingt gleich!
All Roads to Peace#185.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#186.src: Grrmbl... Dumb Kreimu... Human have stalks?
All Roads to Peace#186.dst: Grrmbl... Dumme Kreimu... Mensch hat Stängel?
All Roads to Peace#186.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#187.src: Good. Can take these, then- Alraune girl have sometimes. Tasty, but not good medicine.
All Roads to Peace#187.dst: Gut. Kann die nehmen, dann- Alraune-Mädchen hat manchmal. Lecker, aber keine gute Medizin.
All Roads to Peace#187.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#188.src: Durbeo might like, actually. Durbeo orc in food storage tower behind me. Maybe he want help too?
All Roads to Peace#188.dst: Durbeo mag vielleicht, eigentlich. Durbeo Ork in Vorratsturm hinter mir. Vielleicht will er auch Hilfe?
All Roads to Peace#188.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#189.src: Oh, that human who healed Ressinter. Yes, I've heard of you already. News travels fast here.
All Roads to Peace#189.dst: Oh, der Mensch, der Ressinter geheilt hat. Ja, ich hörte schon von dir. Hier spricht sich alles schnell rum.
All Roads to Peace#189.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#190.src: You have a weird face. Uh, a weird look on your face, I mean. What, not used to a more eloquent orc?
All Roads to Peace#190.dst: Du hast ein komisches Gesicht. Äh, einen komischen Blick, meine ich. Was, kennst du keine wortgewandten Orks?
All Roads to Peace#190.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#191.src: I'm studying languages, is why. I haven't got everything known yet, so if you feel like helping, I could use it.
All Roads to Peace#191.dst: Ich studiere Sprachen, darum. Ich kann noch nicht alles, wenn du also helfen magst, käme mir das gelegen.
All Roads to Peace#191.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#192.src: I used to have a very smart hobbit friend who lived nearby. They've left, but I want you to check their hobbit hole to see if they left behind any language books.
All Roads to Peace#192.dst: Ich hatte einen sehr klugen Hobbitfreund in der Nähe. Er ist fort, aber schau bitte in seiner Hobbithöhle nach, ob er Sprachbücher zurückgelassen hat.
All Roads to Peace#192.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#193.src: It should be close to the blue tower on the hill. That should be easy, right?
All Roads to Peace#193.dst: Sie müsste nahe dem blauen Turm auf dem Hügel sein. Das ist doch leicht, oder?
All Roads to Peace#193.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#194.src: Oh, good, they did leave a book behind. This even completes the collection I have. I have the first, second, fourth, fifth, and sixth volumes of this.
All Roads to Peace#194.dst: Oh, gut, er hat ein Buch zurückgelassen. Damit ist meine Sammlung sogar komplett. Ich habe Band eins, zwei, vier, fünf und sechs.
All Roads to Peace#194.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#195.src: Hopefully I can learn something new here. I still don't understand what all these weird "figures of speech" are supposed to mean...
All Roads to Peace#195.dst: Hoffentlich lerne ich hier etwas Neues. Ich verstehe immer noch nicht, was all diese seltsamen "Redewendungen" bedeuten sollen...
All Roads to Peace#195.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#196.src: What does busting your hump mean? Or two shakes of a lamb tail? Well, anyway. You probably know, so me trying to guess is boring.
All Roads to Peace#196.dst: Was heißt "sich ein Bein ausreißen"? Oder "im Handumdrehen"? Na ja, egal. Du weißt es sicher, also ist mein Raten langweilig.
All Roads to Peace#196.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#197.src: Here, then. That friend of mine wrote everything he came across down in some diaries, and he gave me them to keep, but I can't read them.
All Roads to Peace#197.dst: Dann hier. Mein Freund schrieb alles, was ihm begegnete, in Tagebücher, und gab sie mir zur Aufbewahrung, aber ich kann sie nicht lesen.
All Roads to Peace#197.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#198.src: The pages are too flimsy- I'll rip them if I turn them. It's a good thing the book you gave me is bound with strong leather, but I still need to be careful not to ruin it...
All Roads to Peace#198.dst: Die Seiten sind zu dünn- ich zerreiße sie beim Umblättern. Zum Glück ist das Buch von dir in festes Leder gebunden, aber ich muss trotzdem aufpassen, es nicht zu ruinieren...
All Roads to Peace#198.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#199.src: Well, maybe if you read what these have written in them you can learn some things yourself.
All Roads to Peace#199.dst: Na ja, wenn du liest, was darin steht, lernst du vielleicht selbst etwas.
All Roads to Peace#199.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#200.src: Huh. You again. That weird human who helped Ressinter. Something wrong?
All Roads to Peace#200.dst: Hm. Du schon wieder. Der seltsame Mensch, der Ressinter half. Was ist los?
All Roads to Peace#200.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#201.src: Hm. Looking to help out still? What is it with you looking to be helpful? Have to say I'm not used to this. But, I can think of something.
All Roads to Peace#201.dst: Hm. Willst immer noch helfen? Was ist nur mit dir und dem Helfen? Ich muss sagen, das bin ich nicht gewohnt. Aber mir fällt etwas ein.
All Roads to Peace#201.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#202.src: HEY! Any of you feel like playing a game?
All Roads to Peace#202.dst: HEY! Hat jemand von euch Lust auf ein Spiel?
All Roads to Peace#202.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#203.src: Ugh, yeah! We're so BORED in here!
All Roads to Peace#203.dst: Ugh, ja! Uns ist hier so LANGWEILIG!

All Roads to Peace#204.src: Well, sure, but...even if you say this one isn't so scary, I know I don't wanna tell them my real name!
All Roads to Peace#204.dst: Na ja, klar, aber...auch wenn du sagst, der ist nicht so gruselig, ich will ihm nicht meinen echten Namen sagen!

All Roads to Peace#205.src: Didn't we just eat a bunch of fruit though? We can use those as fake names!
All Roads to Peace#205.dst: Haben wir nicht gerade einen Haufen Obst gegessen? Das nehmen wir als falsche Namen!

All Roads to Peace#206.src: Okay then. Well, call me Mango then, weird human!
All Roads to Peace#206.dst: Okay. Also, nenn mich Mango, seltsamer Mensch!
All Roads to Peace#206.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#207.src: I just ate a bunch of blueberries, so I guess I'm Blueberry for now?
All Roads to Peace#207.dst: Ich hab gerade viele Blaubeeren gegessen, also bin ich wohl erst mal Blueberry?
All Roads to Peace#207.speaker: Blueberry

All Roads to Peace#208.src: Hey, I wouldn't mind being called Grapes by anyone, really!
All Roads to Peace#208.dst: Hey, ich hätte echt nichts dagegen, Grapes genannt zu werden!
All Roads to Peace#208.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#209.src: Then I'm Peaches! So we're just doing a little hide and seek game?
All Roads to Peace#209.dst: Dann bin ich Peaches! Wir spielen also nur ein bisschen Verstecken?
All Roads to Peace#209.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#210.src: Yes. Just hide around the fort someplace. If the human doesn't find you, you win.
All Roads to Peace#210.dst: Ja. Versteckt euch irgendwo in der Festung. Findet der Mensch euch nicht, gewinnt ihr.
All Roads to Peace#210.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#211.src: Well, that's kinda boring, so I'm gonna go find a really tough to reach spot!
All Roads to Peace#211.dst: Na ja, ziemlich langweilig, also suche ich mir einen richtig schwer erreichbaren Ort!
All Roads to Peace#211.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#213.src: Well, there you go. I'll tell you how many you have left to find if you talk with me.
All Roads to Peace#213.dst: Na bitte. Sprich mit mir, dann sage ich dir, wie viele du noch finden musst.
All Roads to Peace#213.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#214.src: ...wow. You're good. I thought you might be able to see me up here, but I didn't think you'd be able to reach me!
All Roads to Peace#214.dst: ...wow. Du bist gut. Ich dachte, du siehst mich hier oben vielleicht, aber nicht, dass du mich erreichst!
All Roads to Peace#214.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#215.src: I don't really care about the fact you're human. As long as I get my entertainment I'm happy. Which kinda isn't so great, cause there isn't a lot here to tinker with.
All Roads to Peace#215.dst: Mir ist egal, dass du ein Mensch bist. Solange ich unterhalten werde, bin ich glücklich. Was nicht so toll ist, weil es hier wenig zum Tüfteln gibt.
All Roads to Peace#215.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#216.src: Tinkernook is so much better about having machines and metals and things to experiment and build than here is.
All Roads to Peace#216.dst: In Tinkernook gibt es viel mehr Maschinen, Metalle und Zeug zum Experimentieren und Bauen als hier.
All Roads to Peace#216.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#217.src: Anyways, you win, I lose, so I better get back to stick-in-the-mud Nunexetor. See ya!
All Roads to Peace#217.dst: Jedenfalls, du gewinnst, ich verliere, also zurück zu Spielverderber Nunexetor. Bis dann!
All Roads to Peace#217.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#218.src: NYACK! For such a big human you really know how to sneak up on someone!!
All Roads to Peace#218.dst: NYACK! Für so einen großen Menschen kannst du dich echt gut anschleichen!!
All Roads to Peace#218.speaker: Blueberry

All Roads to Peace#219.src: Gah, I thought I was a goner for a second there... If Nunny says you're okay then I'll trust him, but that doesn't make you less intimidating!
All Roads to Peace#219.dst: Gah, ich dachte kurz, ich bin erledigt... Wenn Nunny sagt, du bist okay, vertraue ich ihm, aber das macht dich nicht weniger einschüchternd!
All Roads to Peace#219.speaker: Blueberry

All Roads to Peace#220.src: And, I guess out in the open like this, the other orcs wouldn't let you bully us, so...
All Roads to Peace#220.dst: Und hier im Freien würden die anderen Orks wohl nicht zulassen, dass du uns schikanierst, also...
All Roads to Peace#220.speaker: Blueberry

All Roads to Peace#221.src: Suppose you're alright, maybe. But even still, you found me, so I lose. Unless you can't find everyone else!
All Roads to Peace#221.dst: Vielleicht bist du ganz okay. Aber du hast mich gefunden, also verliere ich. Außer du findest die anderen nicht!
All Roads to Peace#221.speaker: Blueberry

All Roads to Peace#222.src: I bet you'll NEVER find Mango, hahaah! She always takes these games SUPER seriously!
All Roads to Peace#222.dst: Wetten, Mango findest du NIE, hahaah! Sie nimmt diese Spiele immer SUPER ernst!
All Roads to Peace#222.speaker: Blueberry

All Roads to Peace#223.src: Aw darn it. I guess it's pretty easy to see me up here.
All Roads to Peace#223.dst: Ach, Mist. Hier oben sieht man mich wohl ziemlich leicht.
All Roads to Peace#223.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#224.src: I mean, I knew that, but I thought you wouldn't think to climb the tower!
All Roads to Peace#224.dst: Ich meine, das wusste ich, aber ich dachte nicht, dass du auf den Turm kletterst!
All Roads to Peace#224.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#225.src: Well, anyway...you really went and tried to heal Ressinter? That's pretty admirable!
All Roads to Peace#225.dst: Na ja, egal...du hast echt versucht, Ressinter zu heilen? Das ist ziemlich bewundernswert!
All Roads to Peace#225.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#226.src: Aaaand then a human went and killed her, because I guess they got told to do so! At least you seem halfway decent.
All Roads to Peace#226.dst: Uuund dann kam ein Mensch und hat sie getötet, wohl weil man es ihm befohlen hat! Du wirkst wenigstens halbwegs anständig.
All Roads to Peace#226.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#227.src: Anyway, back to the quiet ol' grouch with me!
All Roads to Peace#227.dst: Egal, ich geh zurück zum stillen alten Griesgram!
All Roads to Peace#227.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#228.src: Ack! Thought you wouldn't notice me behind the stairs!
All Roads to Peace#228.dst: Ack! Dachte, du siehst mich hinter der Treppe nicht!
All Roads to Peace#228.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#229.src: Ugh, you...you human types are scary up close. Is Nunexetor really sure you're not a bad guy?
All Roads to Peace#229.dst: Ugh, du...ihr Menschen seid von nahem gruselig. Ist Nunexetor sicher, dass du kein Bösewicht bist?
All Roads to Peace#229.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#230.src: I mean, look at your armor! You, you look like you could splat me against the wall in a snap!
All Roads to Peace#230.dst: Ich meine, schau dir deine Rüstung an! Du siehst aus, als könntest du mich im Nu an die Wand klatschen!
All Roads to Peace#230.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#231.src: ...I feel like I just gave you an idea and I'm not sticking around to find out! You win!
All Roads to Peace#231.dst: ...ich glaub, ich hab dich auf eine Idee gebracht, und das will ich nicht rausfinden! Du gewinnst!
All Roads to Peace#231.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#232.src: Looks like the human wins. Guess I know how you managed to find that spineback boar.
All Roads to Peace#232.dst: Sieht aus, als gewinnt der Mensch. Jetzt weiß ich, wie du den Stachelrückeneber gefunden hast.
All Roads to Peace#232.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#233.src: There's no way you REALLY hunted one of those things. Those even give the orc hunters trouble!
All Roads to Peace#233.dst: Du hast niemals WIRKLICH eins von diesen Viechern gejagt. Die machen sogar den Orkjägern zu schaffen!
All Roads to Peace#233.speaker: Blueberry

All Roads to Peace#234.src: Are you kidding me? Humans are terrifying, Blueberry! They've hunted way stronger stuff than some stupid pig!
All Roads to Peace#234.dst: Soll das ein Witz sein? Menschen sind furchterregend, Blueberry! Die haben viel stärkere Sachen gejagt als ein blödes Schwein!
All Roads to Peace#234.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#235.src: But, the game was fun, right?
All Roads to Peace#235.dst: Aber das Spiel hat Spaß gemacht, oder?
All Roads to Peace#235.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#236.src: That's all I wanted from you. Can go back to whatever it was you were doing now.
All Roads to Peace#236.dst: Mehr wollte ich nicht von euch. Ihr könnt jetzt weitermachen, womit ihr beschäftigt wart.
All Roads to Peace#236.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#237.src: Yes, finally! I don't have to spend time wondering if the human's gonna try and poke my eyes out!
All Roads to Peace#237.dst: Ja, endlich! Jetzt muss ich mich nicht mehr fragen, ob der Mensch mir die Augen auskratzen will!
All Roads to Peace#237.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#238.src: Oh, quit being such a scaredy-baby. This one's nice!
All Roads to Peace#238.dst: Ach, sei nicht so ein Angsthase. Der hier ist nett!
All Roads to Peace#238.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#239.src: Good game, I guess! Back to being bored again.
All Roads to Peace#239.dst: Gutes Spiel, schätze ich! Zurück zur Langeweile.
All Roads to Peace#239.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#242.src: What? You aren't even wearing those kinds of shoes.
All Roads to Peace#242.dst: Was? Du trägst nicht mal solche Schuhe.
All Roads to Peace#242.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#243.src: Anyways, to the winner goes the spoils. Here, for entertaining them for a bit.
All Roads to Peace#243.dst: Wie auch immer, dem Sieger die Beute. Hier, weil du sie etwas unterhalten hast.
All Roads to Peace#243.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#244.src: They have me watch the goblins but I'm no good at having fun with them, so thanks I suppose.
All Roads to Peace#244.dst: Ich soll auf die Goblins aufpassen, aber Spaß mit ihnen haben kann ich nicht, also danke, schätze ich.
All Roads to Peace#244.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#245.src: Ah, the weird human. Why you looking to be helpful?
All Roads to Peace#245.dst: Ah, seltsamer Mensch. Warum willst du helfen?
All Roads to Peace#245.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#246.src: The cave outside the villager bridge, with the pond and arch by it. Go in, and there will be blue flowers.
All Roads to Peace#246.dst: Höhle vor Dörfler-Brücke, mit Teich und Bogen daneben. Geh rein, dann blaue Blumen.
All Roads to Peace#246.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#247.src: Get [{~} Terramarine Buds] so can make more dyes. Don't know why you helping, but won't turn down help either.
All Roads to Peace#247.dst: Hol [{~} Terramarine Buds], dann mehr Farbe machen. Weiß nicht, warum du hilfst, aber lehne Hilfe nicht ab.
All Roads to Peace#247.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#248.src: The weird human again? You all covered in blue powder. You found the flowers then!
All Roads to Peace#248.dst: Wieder seltsamer Mensch? Du ganz voll blauem Pulver. Blumen also gefunden!
All Roads to Peace#248.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#249.src: Here. Will get that for you. The buds are enough for what need, but you can keep the dust.
All Roads to Peace#249.dst: Hier. Nehme das. Knospen reichen für, was brauche, aber Staub kannst behalten.
All Roads to Peace#249.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#250.src: Little more, too. But, again- why you looking to be helpful? Don't understand. Humans kill orcs a lot.
All Roads to Peace#250.dst: Bisschen mehr auch. Aber nochmal- warum willst du helfen? Verstehe nicht. Menschen töten viele Orks.
All Roads to Peace#250.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#251.src: You that weird human helping instead killing, right? Nunexetor and little goblins talking about you.
All Roads to Peace#251.dst: Du der seltsame Mensch, der hilft statt tötet, ja? Nunexetor und kleine Goblins reden über dich.
All Roads to Peace#251.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#252.src: Trying to make weapons and tools better. Training, but running out of grindstones. Etemitoro- that is me, my name... That how say it?
All Roads to Peace#252.dst: Versuche Waffen und Werkzeug besser machen. Übe, aber Schleifsteine gehen aus. Etemitoro- das ich, mein Name... Sagt man so?
All Roads to Peace#252.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#253.src: Weird human language. Anyway, know where good grindstone is- top of mountain east of fortress.
All Roads to Peace#253.dst: Seltsame Menschensprache. Egal, weiß, wo guter Schleifstein ist- Spitze von Berg östlich von Festung.
All Roads to Peace#253.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#254.src: There shortcut running through top by Ledant cave. Maybe dangerous, but not too much. Follow dead bushes on road and can get to top quickly.
All Roads to Peace#254.dst: Da Abkürzung oben bei Ledant-Höhle. Vielleicht gefährlich, aber nicht zu sehr. Folg toten Büschen auf Weg, dann schnell oben.
All Roads to Peace#254.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#255.src: May have something useful if bring me [Leaden Stone] for grind metal.
All Roads to Peace#255.dst: Hab vielleicht Nützliches, wenn bringst [Leaden Stone] für Metall schleifen.
All Roads to Peace#255.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#256.src: Look- human want help? Then get Etemitoro- that is me, my name... Get-
All Roads to Peace#256.dst: Schau- Mensch will helfen? Dann hol Etemitoro- das ich, mein Name... Hol-
All Roads to Peace#256.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#257.src: Oh! You have [Leaden Stone]! Was focusing on work, didn't notice.
All Roads to Peace#257.dst: Oh! Du hast [Leaden Stone]! War auf Arbeit konzentriert, nicht gemerkt.
All Roads to Peace#257.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#258.src: Here. Human like green gem for money, right? Not good for smithing though.
All Roads to Peace#258.dst: Hier. Mensch mag grünen Stein für Geld, ja? Aber nicht gut für Schmieden.
All Roads to Peace#258.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#259.src: Hm, healer human. Could swear, saw you walking around plains some time ago. What here for? Ressinter hurt again?
All Roads to Peace#259.dst: Hm, Heiler-Mensch. Könnte schwören, sah dich vor Zeit in Ebenen laufen. Was hier? Ressinter wieder verletzt?
All Roads to Peace#259.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#260.src: No? Well, am curious now. You try heal Ressinter...luck, maybe? Or did human really know what herbs do?
All Roads to Peace#260.dst: Nein? Na, jetzt neugierig. Du heilst Ressinter...Glück vielleicht? Oder weiß Mensch wirklich, was Kräuter tun?
All Roads to Peace#260.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#261.src: Want review. Want see human medicine knowledge. Will ask questions, human give answer. Simple. Ready?
All Roads to Peace#261.dst: Will prüfen. Will Medizinwissen von Mensch sehen. Stelle Fragen, Mensch antwortet. Einfach. Bereit?
All Roads to Peace#261.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#263.src: Good! So, first question. Ginkgo Leaf. What Gingko Leaf good for?
All Roads to Peace#263.dst: Gut! Also, erste Frage. Ginkgoblatt. Wofür Ginkgoblatt gut?
All Roads to Peace#263.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#264.src: Yes! Good. Gingko leaf help brain. Make feel better when stress, but make blood runny. Can be good for sometimes, but can be dangerous.
All Roads to Peace#264.dst: Ja! Gut. Ginkgoblatt hilft Kopf. Gut bei Stress, aber macht Blut dünn. Manchmal gut, aber kann gefährlich sein.
All Roads to Peace#264.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#265.src: So, second question. Sweetgale. What Sweetgale good for?
All Roads to Peace#265.dst: Also, zweite Frage. Gagel. Wofür Gagel gut?
All Roads to Peace#265.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#267.src: Nope. Sweetgale not for helping with that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#267.dst: Nein. Gagel nicht dafür. Hm, vielleicht Mensch heilt Ressinter durch Glück... Kannst nochmal versuchen.
All Roads to Peace#267.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#270.src: Here third question. Elderberry. Elderberry good for two thing. What Elderberry good for?
All Roads to Peace#270.dst: Hier dritte Frage. Holunder. Holunder gut für zwei Dinge. Wofür Holunder gut?
All Roads to Peace#270.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#271.src: No, Elderberry not good for those. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#271.dst: Nein, Holunder nicht gut dafür. Hm, vielleicht Mensch heilt Ressinter durch Glück... Kannst nochmal versuchen.
All Roads to Peace#271.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#272.src: It soothes pain and treats c
All Roads to Peace#272.dst: Er lindert Schmerzen und hilft bei Erkältung.

All Roads to Peace#273.src: Yes! Though, Elderberry also good for third thing. Can make good drink! Get drunk if ferment Elderberry, but that not medicine.
All Roads to Peace#273.dst: Ja! Aber Holunder auch gut für drittes Ding. Macht gutes Getränk! Wirst betrunken, wenn Holunder gärt, aber das keine Medizin.
All Roads to Peace#273.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#274.src: Last question for human. Feverfew. What Feverfew NOT help with?
All Roads to Peace#274.dst: Letzte Frage für Mensch. Mutterkraut. Wobei Mutterkraut NICHT hilft?
All Roads to Peace#274.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#276.src: Feverfew very good for heal that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#276.dst: Mutterkraut sehr gut, das zu heilen. Hm, vielleicht Mensch heilt Ressinter durch Glück... Kannst nochmal versuchen.
All Roads to Peace#276.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#278.dst: Ein Date mit dir zu bekommen.

All Roads to Peace#281.src: That...correct! Not right, but correct! You...haha, you only help Ressinter through luck, right? Human not actually healer.
All Roads to Peace#281.dst: Das...richtig! Nicht korrekt, aber richtig! Du...haha, du hilfst Ressinter nur durch Glück, ja? Mensch nicht echt Heiler.
All Roads to Peace#281.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#282.src: Human have humor though! And human try hard to help. More than can say for most humans. Here then- try more heal, instead of be soldier.
All Roads to Peace#282.dst: Mensch hat aber Humor! Und Mensch strengt sich an zu helfen. Mehr als bei meisten Menschen. Hier- mehr heilen, statt Soldat sein.
All Roads to Peace#282.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#283.src: World need more people to help other people. That human was willing to try mean many good thing.
All Roads to Peace#283.dst: Welt braucht mehr Leute, die anderen helfen. Dass Mensch versuchen wollte, heißt viel Gutes.
All Roads to Peace#283.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#284.src: It aids in sleep and soothes
All Roads to Peace#284.dst: Er hilft beim Schlafen und lindert Entzündungen.

All Roads to Peace#285.src: No. Gingko Leaf bad for that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#285.dst: Nein. Ginkgoblatt schlecht dafür. Hm, vielleicht Mensch heilt Ressinter durch Glück... Kannst nochmal versuchen.
All Roads to Peace#285.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#288.src: Fine. Take your time. Will be here for while to make sure other healer okay.
All Roads to Peace#288.dst: Gut. Lass dir Zeit. Bin eine Weile hier, um sicherzugehen, anderer Heiler okay.
All Roads to Peace#288.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#289.src: Human healer! Hello! This Onluk tower. Onluk tower two! Human help, so human welcome.
All Roads to Peace#289.dst: Mensch-Heiler! Hallo! Das Onluk-Turm. Onluk-Turm zwei! Mensch hilft, also Mensch willkommen.
All Roads to Peace#289.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#290.src: Tower one call tower one cause Onluk build tower one! This not usual spot for Onluk.
All Roads to Peace#290.dst: Turm eins heißt Turm eins, weil Onluk Turm eins gebaut! Das nicht üblicher Platz für Onluk.
All Roads to Peace#290.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#291.src: Usually at tower on small hill, across bridge. But because build tower by self, tower rickety.
All Roads to Peace#291.dst: Meist auf Turm auf kleinem Hügel, über Brücke. Aber weil Turm allein gebaut, Turm wackelig.
All Roads to Peace#291.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#292.src: Human helpful. Human get sturdy wood for fix tower? {p} has sturdy wood. Forest has wood too, but more magical than sturdy.
All Roads to Peace#292.dst: Mensch hilfreich. Mensch holt festes Holz, Turm reparieren? {p} hat festes Holz. Wald hat auch Holz, aber mehr magisch als fest.
All Roads to Peace#292.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#293.src: Aha! Human have willow wood! Onluk fix tower now!
All Roads to Peace#293.dst: Aha! Mensch hat Weidenholz! Onluk repariert Turm jetzt!
All Roads to Peace#293.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#294.src: Will repair Onluk tower one! Come see after fix!
All Roads to Peace#294.dst: Repariere Onluk-Turm eins! Komm sehen nach Reparatur!
All Roads to Peace#294.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#295.src: TOWER ONE REPAIRED! Hrahaaah! Yes! Human very helpful!
All Roads to Peace#295.dst: TURM EINS REPARIERT! Hrahaaah! Ja! Mensch sehr hilfreich!
All Roads to Peace#295.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#296.src: Should go and see! Climb tower, shoot crossbow at Freelancer!
All Roads to Peace#296.dst: Solltest sehen gehen! Turm klettern, Armbrust auf Freelancer schießen!
All Roads to Peace#296.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#297.src: See? Onluk tower one much better than Onluk tower two! Cozy up here, and can see Fruludir tower too!
All Roads to Peace#297.dst: Siehst? Onluk-Turm eins viel besser als Onluk-Turm zwei! Gemütlich hier oben, und sieht Fruludir-Turm auch!
All Roads to Peace#297.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#298.src: Human very helpful. Healer and woodcutter! Repairer of tower- Well, human not repair tower. Helper of repairer of tower!
All Roads to Peace#298.dst: Mensch sehr hilfreich. Heiler und Holzfäller! Reparierer von Turm- Na, Mensch nicht Turm repariert. Helfer von Reparierer von Turm!
All Roads to Peace#298.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#299.src: Here, for help repair Onluk tower one!
All Roads to Peace#299.dst: Hier, für Hilfe bei Onluk-Turm eins!
All Roads to Peace#299.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#300.src: Speak to Ureietun at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to gain access to the Chieftess' hut
All Roads to Peace#300.dst: Sprich mit Ureietun bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], um Zutritt zur Hütte der Häuptlingin zu erhalten

All Roads to Peace#302.src: Human want talk Arrai-Veretel. In hut. Follow.
All Roads to Peace#302.dst: Mensch will reden mit Arrai-Veretel. In Hütte. Folgen.
All Roads to Peace#302.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#303.src: Arrai-Veretel! Human try help orc around fortress. Want talk.
All Roads to Peace#303.dst: Arrai-Veretel! Mensch versucht, Orks in Festung helfen. Will reden.
All Roads to Peace#303.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#304.src: Up to human now. Will not help more- choice is up to Arrai-Veretel.
All Roads to Peace#304.dst: Jetzt Sache von Mensch. Helfe nicht mehr- Wahl liegt bei Arrai-Veretel.
All Roads to Peace#304.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#305.src: Hmh. Zuett spoke about you. So you are human trying to end war?
All Roads to Peace#305.dst: Hmh. Zuett sprach von dir. Du also Mensch, der Krieg beenden will?
All Roads to Peace#305.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#307.src: YOU! You human who kill Rai-Poxper! You human who attack other fort!
All Roads to Peace#307.dst: DU! Du Mensch, der Rai-Poxper tötet! Du Mensch, der andere Festung angreift!
All Roads to Peace#307.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#308.src: Need talk with Zuett again. You follow. And you stay quiet. Understand?
All Roads to Peace#308.dst: Muss nochmal mit Zuett reden. Du folgst. Und du bist still. Verstanden?
All Roads to Peace#308.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#309.src: Follow Arrai-Veretel into the meeting room at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
All Roads to Peace#309.dst: Folge Arrai-Veretel in den Besprechungsraum bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

All Roads to Peace#310.src: ZUETT! You say human want peace. Do you know who human is?!
All Roads to Peace#310.dst: ZUETT! Du sagst, Mensch will Frieden. Weißt du, wer Mensch ist?!
All Roads to Peace#310.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#311.src: Whuh- This good human! Heal Ressinter-
All Roads to Peace#311.dst: Whuh- Das guter Mensch! Heilt Ressinter-
All Roads to Peace#311.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#314.src: Human ALSO attack other fort! Many orcs dead because this human!
All Roads to Peace#314.dst: Mensch greift AUCH andere Festung an! Viele Orks tot wegen diesem Mensch!
All Roads to Peace#314.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#316.src: Human attack! Rai-Poxper take rightful toll for break cease-fire, but not war yet. Take magic axe from Villager city while magic power gone bad.
All Roads to Peace#316.dst: Mensch greift an! Rai-Poxper holt gerechten Preis für Bruch von Waffenruhe, aber noch nicht Krieg. Nimmt Zauberaxt aus Dörfler-Stadt, als Magie schlecht wurde.
All Roads to Peace#316.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#317.src: Villager and human attack first, but attack orc for take rightful toll like orc attack first! And human kill Rai-Poxper!
All Roads to Peace#317.dst: Dörfler und Mensch greifen zuerst an, aber greifen Ork an für gerechten Preis, als ob Ork zuerst! Und Mensch tötet Rai-Poxper!
All Roads to Peace#317.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#318.src: Then same human who kill Rai-Poxper come, kill bathing orc, break in fort, kill many Centerworld orc! Villager start, orc finish, villager no respect end!
All Roads to Peace#318.dst: Dann kommt gleicher Mensch, tötet badenden Ork, bricht in Festung ein, tötet viele Centerworld-Orks! Dörfler fangen an, Ork beendet, Dörfler achten Ende nicht!
All Roads to Peace#318.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#319.src: Yes, human tricked by Villager. But human still attack orc. Human still kill many orc! Human say want peace now?
All Roads to Peace#319.dst: Ja, Mensch von Dörfler getäuscht. Aber greift trotzdem Ork an. Tötet trotzdem viele Orks! Und will jetzt Frieden?
All Roads to Peace#319.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#320.src: What human done? Hunt boar? Help healer? Done busywork for other orc? That not make up for life lost.
All Roads to Peace#320.dst: Was Mensch getan? Eber gejagt? Heiler geholfen? Kleinkram für andere Orks? Das macht verlorenes Leben nicht gut.
All Roads to Peace#320.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#321.src: ...Arrai-Veretel right. What human done good, not make up for that. But, human still trying. If one human try to stop, more human can try to stop.
All Roads to Peace#321.dst: ...Arrai-Veretel hat recht. Gutes von Mensch macht das nicht gut. Aber Mensch versucht. Wenn ein Mensch aufhören will, können mehr Menschen aufhören.
All Roads to Peace#321.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#322.src: Maybe. Maybe more orc be dead instead. Zuett, you cannot say what would happened. Wishful thinking, and I wish would happened too!
All Roads to Peace#322.dst: Vielleicht. Vielleicht stattdessen mehr Orks tot. Zuett, du kannst nicht sagen, was passiert. Wunschdenken, und ich wünsche auch, es passiert!
All Roads to Peace#322.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#323.src: But with unfinished Wynnic, orc cannot talk well. YOU try learn language when idiot killing you! All sound stupid, and no time to learn for most!
All Roads to Peace#323.dst: Aber mit halbem Wynnisch können Orks nicht gut reden. DU versuch Sprache lernen, wenn Idiot dich tötet! Alles klingt dumm, und meiste keine Zeit zum Lernen!
All Roads to Peace#323.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#324.src: But human listen to Zuett, even if not sound smart. Arrai-Veretel not respect human. Justified, but still cause problem.
All Roads to Peace#324.dst: Aber Mensch hört Zuett zu, auch wenn nicht klug klingt. Arrai-Veretel achtet Mensch nicht. Berechtigt, aber macht trotzdem Problem.
All Roads to Peace#324.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#325.src: Grrh. FINE! Zuett want peace so bad? Human want peace so bad? Human spilled much orc blood. Only way out of war, is through. We will battle.
All Roads to Peace#325.dst: Grrh. GUT! Zuett will so sehr Frieden? Mensch will so sehr Frieden? Mensch vergoss viel Orkblut. Einziger Weg aus Krieg ist hindurch. Wir kämpfen.
All Roads to Peace#325.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#326.src: No tricks. No backup. Nothing but battle between human and myself. If human can fight in ritual arena and win, then will listen.
All Roads to Peace#326.dst: Keine Tricks. Keine Verstärkung. Nur Kampf zwischen Mensch und mir. Wenn Mensch in Ritualarena kämpft und gewinnt, dann höre ich zu.
All Roads to Peace#326.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#327.src: Try threaten us with iron corpse machine! So, battle will happen. Will prepare ritual and gather crowd. Prepare, human.
All Roads to Peace#327.dst: Wollen uns mit Eisenleichen-Maschine drohen! Also gibt Kampf. Bereite Ritual vor und hole Zuschauer. Mach dich bereit, Mensch.
All Roads to Peace#327.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#328.src: Defeat Arrai-Veretel in combat in the arena below the orcish meeting room.
All Roads to Peace#328.dst: Besiege Arrai-Veretel im Kampf in der Arena unter dem Besprechungsraum der Orks.

All Roads to Peace#329.src: May the earth herself hear us... Though we do not speak as we once have...
All Roads to Peace#329.dst: Möge die Erde selbst uns hören... Auch wenn wir nicht mehr sprechen wie einst...
All Roads to Peace#329.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#330.src: We, as humble inhabitants of the land she has gifted us, pledge this show in honor of her.
All Roads to Peace#330.dst: Wir, demütige Bewohner des Landes, das sie uns schenkte, widmen ihr diesen Kampf zu Ehren.
All Roads to Peace#330.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#331.src: May she be sated, grow healthy, and honor us in turn for this offering.
All Roads to Peace#331.dst: Möge sie satt sein, gesund gedeihen und uns für dieses Opfer ehren.
All Roads to Peace#331.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#334.src: HMH! Human tough. Fine- Will take battle seriously now!
All Roads to Peace#334.dst: HMH! Mensch zäh. Gut- Kampf jetzt ernst nehmen!
All Roads to Peace#334.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#335.src: For sake of those killed before me, I will not lose!
All Roads to Peace#335.dst: Für die, die vor mir getötet wurden, verliere ich nicht!
All Roads to Peace#335.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#338.src: No, no! Arrai-Veretel hurt bad! Human try kill Arrai-Veretel!!
All Roads to Peace#338.dst: Nein, nein! Arrai-Veretel schlimm verletzt! Mensch will Arrai-Veretel töten!!
All Roads to Peace#338.speaker: Audience Orc

All Roads to Peace#339.src: AM FINE! Stupid, idiot! No interrupting while ritual fight!
All Roads to Peace#339.dst: BIN OKAY! Dummer Idiot! Kein Stören bei Ritualkampf!
All Roads to Peace#339.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#340.src: Human win. Hate to say, but human win. Not even try kill me.
All Roads to Peace#340.dst: Mensch gewinnt. Hasse es, aber Mensch gewinnt. Will mich nicht mal töten.
All Roads to Peace#340.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#341.src: Give time. Battle hard-fought- Need to wind down. Wait in meeting room. Will...discuss terms.
All Roads to Peace#341.dst: Gib Zeit. Kampf hart- Muss runterkommen. Warte in Besprechungsraum. Werde...Bedingungen besprechen.
All Roads to Peace#341.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#342.src: Feel like insult to stop war we did not start. But, gave promise. Human strong. Still not make up for so much death...
All Roads to Peace#342.dst: Fühlt sich an wie Beleidigung, Krieg beenden, den wir nicht anfingen. Aber gab Versprechen. Mensch stark. Macht so viel Tod nicht gut...
All Roads to Peace#342.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#343.src: But human trying. Really, really trying. Will admit, did not know about human killing all when saw... Still. If war ending, deaths also ending.
All Roads to Peace#343.dst: Aber Mensch versucht. Wirklich, wirklich versucht. Gebe zu, wusste nicht, Mensch tötet so viele, als sah... Trotzdem. Wenn Krieg endet, endet auch Sterben.
All Roads to Peace#343.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#344.src: Will stop attacking cities. Orcs still defend selves! Will not turn bellies for spears. Still not trust villagers- only give cease-fire.
All Roads to Peace#344.dst: Hören auf, Städte angreifen. Orks verteidigen sich trotzdem! Zeigen Speeren nicht Bauch. Trauen Dörflern noch nicht- nur Waffenruhe.
All Roads to Peace#344.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#345.src: Will say- many orc hold grudge, in plains. Many orc probably still attack. If so, human also can defend self. But, human should avoid fight there.
